z-m-36-01.s.s2.ok.c1: Cikakken adadi ne na halitta daga 1 zuwa 30.
z-m-36-01.title: Sharudda biyu da ke kaiwa ga wuri ɗaya: menene dangantakarsu?
z-m-36-01.topic: Abin da za a iya sani da wanda ba za a iya sani ba idan sharudda biyu suka kai ga sharadi ɗaya (haɗuwar rukunin gaskiya)
z-m-36-01.goal: Daga bayanin “idan p, to q” da “idan r, to q” gaskiya ne kaɗai, ka tsara maganganun da aka tabbatar da waɗanda ba a sani ba ta amfani da haɗuwar rukunin gaskiya; nuna waɗanda ba a tabbatar ba da misalan da ke karyata su; sannan ka faɗi ƙarin abin da ake bukata don tabbatar da su.
z-m-36-01.material:
Idan aka ba da babban rukuni U, ka yi la’akari da sharudda uku p, q, r. Bari rukunin gaskiyarsu su zama P, Q, R. Ga abubuwa biyun da aka sani kawai.
(가) Maganar “idan p, to q” gaskiya ce. (P ƙaramin rukuni ne na Q.)
(나) Maganar “idan r, to q” gaskiya ce. (R ƙaramin rukuni ne na Q.)
Ba a san dangantakar da ke tsakanin P da R ba. Domin a fahimta da kalmomi kaɗai ba tare da hoto ba, za ka iya zana shi da cewa “P yana cikin Q, R ma yana cikin Q”.
z-m-36-01.thinking.0: Bambance abin da bayanin da aka bayar ya tabbatar da abin da “ba a sani ba”.
z-m-36-01.thinking.1: Yanke hukunci ta hanyar mayar da sharudda zuwa haɗuwar rukunin gaskiya.
z-m-36-01.thinking.2: Ka ƙirƙiri misalan da ke karyata maganar da kanka domin nuna cewa “ba koyaushe take gaskiya ba”.
z-m-36-01.thinking.3: Faɗi bayanin da ya ɓace wanda ake bukata don tabbatar da ƙarshe.
z-m-36-01.prereq.0: Idan maganar “idan p, to q” gaskiya ce, rukunin gaskiya P ƙaramin rukuni ne na Q; kuma akasin hanyar maganar yana da ƙimar gaskiya iri ɗaya da asalin maganar (ana ɗauka cewa ɗalibi ya yi nazarin ɓangaren farko na Lissafi na gama-gari “rukuni da maganganu”; H2 alamar wahala ce kawai ta wannan aikin, ba matsayin aji ba).
z-m-36-01.prereq.1: Ma’anar haɗawa, tsaka-tsaki da cikawa, da kuma ninkin lambobi da masu raba su.
z-m-36-01.s.s1.prompt: Idan abin da aka sani su ne (가) da (나) kaɗai, zaɓi duk maganganun da za ka iya tabbatarwa cewa koyaushe gaskiya ne. (Kada ka zaɓi maganganun da ba za a iya tabbatarwa ba.)
z-m-36-01.s.s1.hint.0: Zana hotuna biyu ko fiye dabam-dabam inda P da R suke cikin Q kowannensu. (Misali, hoto inda suke haɗuwa, da wani inda ba sa haɗuwa.)
z-m-36-01.s.s1.hint.1: Sake rubuta kowace magana a matsayin haɗuwa kamar “P ƙaramin rukuni ne na Q”, sannan ka bincika ko gaskiya ce a kowane hoton da ka zana. Akwai magana da gaskiyarta ke canzawa bisa hoton?
z-m-36-01.s.s1.r.a: Abin da aka sani kawai shi ne P da R duk suna cikin Q. Kasancewa cikin rukuni ɗaya ba yana nufin ɗaya ya ƙunshi ɗayan ba. Ka zana hotunan da rukunan biyu ba sa haɗuwa ko kuma ɗaya ne kawai babba.
z-m-36-01.s.s1.o.b: Idan ba q ba, to ba p ba
z-m-36-01.s.s1.r.b: Ka karanta (가) bayan an mayar da ita zuwa maganarta ta akasin hanya. Wannan hukunci yana amfani da gaskiyar cewa maganar akasin hanya tana da ƙimar gaskiya iri ɗaya da asalin maganar.
z-m-36-01.s.s1.r.c: Wannan akasin maganar (나) ce. Ko da magana gaskiya ce, akasinta na iya zama gaskiya ko ƙarya. Zana hoto inda Q ya fi R girma.
z-m-36-01.s.s1.o.d: Idan p ko r, to q
z-m-36-01.s.s1.r.d: Wannan hukunci yana bincika ko haɗaɗɗen ɓangaren P da R yana cikin Q. Idan kowannensu yana cikin Q, haɗaɗɗensu ma yana cikin Q.
z-m-36-01.s.s1.o.e: Idan p da r, to q
z-m-36-01.s.s1.r.e: Wannan hukunci yana bincika ko ɓangaren gama-gari na P da R yana cikin Q. Wannan ɓangaren gama-gari ma wani ɓangare ne na P. Ka kuma yi tunani game da yanayin da babu wani ɓangare na gama-gari.
z-m-36-01.s.s1.o.f: Idan ba r ba, to ba p ba
z-m-36-01.s.s1.r.f: Wannan magana ita ce akasin hanyar “idan p, to r”. Idan ba a tabbatar da waccan maganar ba, wannan ma ba a tabbatar da ita ba.
z-m-36-01.s.s1.explain: Abin da (가) da (나) suka tabbatar shi ne kawai abin da ya biyo kai tsaye daga P⊂Q da R⊂Q. “Idan ba q ba, to ba p ba” ita ce akasin hanyar (가); “idan p ko r, to q” ita ce P∪R⊂Q; kuma “idan p da r, to q” ita ce P∩R⊂Q. A gefe guda, “idan p, to r” (P⊂R) da akasin hanyarta, da “idan q, to r” (Q⊂R), na iya zama gaskiya ko ƙarya bisa yadda aka sanya P, R, da Q, saboda haka wannan bayanin kaɗai ba ya tabbatar da su. “Ba a tabbatar ba” ya bambanta da “ƙarya ne”.
z-m-36-01.s.s2.prompt: Yanzu bari mu duba takamaiman yanayi. Babban rukuni U shi ne lambobin ƙidaya daga 1 zuwa 30. q yana nufin “lamba ce mai rabo da 2 ba tare da saura ba”, p yana nufin “ninkin 4 ce”, r kuma yana nufin “ninkin 6 ce”. To (가) da (나) duk gaskiya ne. Nemo ka shigar da lambobi x guda 3 dabam-dabam da p yake gaskiya amma r yake ƙarya.
z-m-36-01.s.s2.hint.0: Da farko, jera duk lambobi daga 1 zuwa 30 da suka cika sharadin p (ninkin 4).
z-m-36-01.s.s2.hint.1: Ga kowace lamba da ka jera, bincika sharadin r (ko ninkin 6 ce), sannan ka riƙe lambobin da ba su cika shi ba kawai.
z-m-36-01.s.s2.fail.c1: Dole ne x ya zama lambar ƙidaya daga 1 zuwa 30.
z-m-36-01.s.s2.ok.c2: Ninkin 4 ce, saboda haka p gaskiya ne.
z-m-36-01.s.s2.fail.c2: Ba ninkin 4 ba ce, saboda haka p ba gaskiya ba ne.
z-m-36-01.s.s2.ok.c3: Ba ninkin 6 ba ce, saboda haka r ƙarya ne.
z-m-36-01.s.s2.fail.c3: Ninkin 6 ce, saboda haka r gaskiya ne. Dole ne ta zama lambar da r yake ƙarya a kanta.
z-m-36-01.s.s2.explain: Daga 1 zuwa 30, ninkin 4 su ne 4, 8, 12, 16, 20, 24, 28; idan aka cire 12 da 24 waɗanda su ma ninkin 6 ne, sai a samu 4, 8, 16, 20, 28, waɗanda suka cika sharadin. Idan akwai ko da lamba guda ɗaya irin wannan, “idan p, to r” ƙarya ce. Ko a wannan yanayin (가) da (나) har yanzu gaskiya ne, don haka an tabbatar da cewa (가) da (나) kaɗai ba za su iya tabbatar da “idan p, to r” ba.
z-m-36-01.s.s3.prompt: Jiho ya ce, “p da r duk suna cikin q, don haka ‘idan p, to r’ ma dole ta zama gaskiya.” Rubuta ra’ayinka game da maganar Jiho. Ka kuma rubuta ko abin da ka fara zaɓa a s1 ya canza (ko ya kasance iri ɗaya) bayan yin s2, sannan ka faɗi ƙarin bayanin da ake bukata don tabbatar da cewa “idan p, to r” gaskiya ne.
z-m-36-01.s.s3.hint.0: Zaɓi lamba guda daga waɗanda ka ƙirƙira a s2, sannan ka fara rubuta ko p da r kowannensu gaskiya ne ko ƙarya.
z-m-36-01.s.s3.hint.1: Ka yi tunani game da yadda wata magana guda da ke haɗa p da r kai tsaye za ta kasance, sannan ka bincika ko lambar da ka zaɓa yanzu har yanzu za ta yiwu idan akwai wannan maganar.
z-m-36-01.s.s3.placeholder: Misali: Maganar Jiho ... domin ... Don tabbatar da ita ...
z-m-36-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: A cikin lambar da na bayar, za a iya ganin a sarari cewa p gaskiya ne, r kuma ƙarya ne?
z-m-36-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Na rubuta “ba za a iya tabbatarwa ba” da “ƙarya ne” a matsayin abubuwa dabam?
z-m-36-01.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Idan ƙarin bayanin da na ambata yana nan, na bincika da misali guda cewa “idan p, to r” da gaske ta zama gaskiya?
z-m-36-01.s.s3.selfAssess.3: Idan abin da na fara zaɓa a s1 ya canza, na rubuta dalilin; idan ya kasance iri ɗaya, na bayyana dalilin da ya sa?
z-m-36-01.s.s3.model.0: Ba za a iya tabbatar da maganar Jiho ba. 4 ninkin 4 ce, saboda haka p gaskiya ne, amma ba ninkin 6 ba ce, saboda haka r ƙarya ne. Duk da haka (가) da (나) sun kasance gaskiya, don haka kasancewa cikin q kaɗai bai wadatar ba. Muna bukatar wani bayani da ke haɗa p da r kai tsaye, kamar cewa P yana cikin R.
z-m-36-01.s.s3.modelNote.0: Idan ba ka zaɓi “idan p, to r” a farko ba, wannan yanayi ne da hukuncinka ya kasance iri ɗaya; za ka iya rubuta cewa binciken misali ya ƙara maka ƙwarin gwiwa.
z-m-36-01.s.s3.model.1: Ba zan iya tabbatar da ko gaskiya ce ba. 16 ninkin 4 ce amma ba ninkin 6 ba ce, don haka misali ne da ke karyata ta. Amma idan muka kuma koyi “idan q, to r”, P yana cikin Q kuma Q yana cikin R, saboda haka P ma yana cikin R, kuma “idan p, to r” ta zama gaskiya. Da farko ta yi kama da gaskiya, amma na sami misalin da ke karyata ta kuma na canza ra’ayina.
z-m-36-01.s.s3.modelNote.1: Amsa ce da ke bayar da sabon bayani guda ɗaya kuma ta bayyana dalilin da ya sa ya wadatar. Idan R=Q, idan aka haɗa da (나) sai ya zama “idan q, to r”, don haka wata hanya ce ta faɗin amsa iri ɗaya.
